summary: Iteration 159: Complete testing of 'Origen del Cliente' (Referidor) system. All 7 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified - single dropdown 'Origen del Cliente' with 14 options (master list + new options). Cascade behavior: 'Banco' shows bank dropdown (31 banks), 'Cliente Referidor' shows searchable client dropdown (50+ clients), other origins (Correo de Ventas, Integrador, etc.) do NOT show secondary dropdown.

issues: HTML hydration warning: <tr> cannot be child of <span> - cosmetic React warning, does not affect functionality

critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/clients/referidor-options returns 30+ banks and 315+ clients correctly
POST /api/clients with referidor='Banco' creates client with referidor_tipo='BANCO' and bank_id
POST /api/clients with referidor='Cliente Referidor' creates client with referidor_tipo='CLIENTE' and client_id
POST /api/clients with referidor='Correo de Ventas' creates client with referidor_tipo='OTRO' (no secondary dropdown)
POST /api/clients with referidor='Integrador' creates client with referidor_tipo='OTRO' (no secondary dropdown)
PUT /api/clients/{id} updates referidor from 'Integrador' to 'Banco' with referidor_id successfully
GET /api/clients/{id} returns referidor, referidor_tipo, referidor_id, referidor_nombre fields
Frontend 'Datos de Captación' section visible with 'Origen del Cliente' dropdown
Frontend dropdown shows all 14 options + 'Sin especificar'
Frontend cascade: 'Banco' → bank dropdown, 'Cliente Referidor' → client dropdown with search
Frontend cascade: Other origins (Correo de Ventas, Integrador, etc.) → NO secondary dropdown
seed_data_creation: Test clients created and cleaned up during tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Origen del Cliente feature fully implemented. The client form has a single dropdown 'Origen del Cliente' with 14 options from REFERIDOR_OPTIONS (Correo de Ventas, Integrador, Directores, Corporativo, Jose Dolande, Melissa Garcia, Katherine Quailey, Rafael Gonzalez, Ventas Directas (Ejecutivo), Página Web / Landing Page, Redes Sociales, Alianzas Externas, Banco, Cliente Referidor). Only 'Banco' and 'Cliente Referidor' trigger a secondary dropdown. The field 'referidor' stores the selected origin, 'referidor_tipo' stores BANCO/CLIENTE/OTRO, and 'referidor_id'/'referidor_nombre' store the bank/client details when applicable.
